notes.title: Massive update!
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce that the final big update will be available soon! It will be followed by a weeks wait while we respond to all new useful feedback and work on any further issues, there will be an update coming slightly later for level Z order improvements and a quit button to bypass Steam's game close issue.
A list of updates:
- Many bug fixes from tutorials to levels.
- The last level is created, take control of Cutlass' ship for a final confrontation with Ripper.
- Even further lag reductions.
- Some menu controls that were causing issues have been removed (keyboard/gamepad) and so the game has changed to 'Partial controller support'.
- General clean up/edit of menus and UIs!
Thank you so much to the support players have given myself over the past few months, it has been a huge learning curve and has taken Guardians from a buggy, laggy mess into something to be proud of!

notes.title: Massive Lag Reduction!
notes.content:
Changes:
- New End-level menu design
- Massive lag reduction (console predicted just over 1GB)
- 3 factory levels, one for each character!
- Lots of core bug fixing, which will hopefully stop users from not being able to move, or being dead at the start of levels

Small list, big changes! Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.7!
notes.content:
'Update 1.7 finally brings more levels! Ripper’s Domain will be available to play, and you don’t need to have completed the Daylight levels first.
 These levels are slightly harder, as it’s expected as the story goes on, that players will have used up some skillpoints in the menu book.
 The most important change is to avoid building fires. These are relatively low damage, but they are frequent, as this part of the flying city is in ruin. There are less enemies for that reason though. Expect some whackiness! Firearm’s aiming was atrocious, the crosshair simply didn’t meet the demand of lots
 of movement, in a fast-paced environment that forces you to stay on your toes, it just kept being left behind him. I am very pleased to announce that with the next update, the crosshair has gone, and you now directly control the angle of his arm, using Z/C for arrow users, num 4/6 for WASD users, and the right stick for controllers.'

notes.title: Patch 1.6!
notes.content:
Full Controller Support!

- You should now find you can traverse the whole of the game with your controller, WASD, arrow keys, or mouse.
- The main menu has merged with the second menu seamlessly, making it far more visually captivating.
- The settings options and display is great improved too, with the options also being included in the pause menu- mid-game. Included is the controls. So you can view controls mid-mission also.
- Based on what I have seen by Lets Players, people really wanted to destroy turrets! And now you can!

As ever please like us @Facebook with /kenthria and /tallstorystudios, and check out www.tallstorystudios for more in depth guidance!

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is live!
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for bearing with us while we work out any bugs you find! Update 1.2 is now live, which brings a plethora of fixes/changes:

- Visual feedback for player health and enemy health loss.
 - Fixed an issue with defeating Brute enemies.
 - Clearer graphics... only the platformable objects are clearly visible, along with npcs and enemies.
 - Brella now deals damage more accurately to enemies trying to invade her personal space.
 - Ripper's progress slowed in normal and easy difficulty modes due to player feedback
 - Combat Arena training is now called 'Combat Arena'.
 -Ripper's bullets no longer disintegrate when hitting objects, adding a new dimension to the challenge.
 - Some progress on gamepad integration, starting with action responsiveness.
 - Combat tutorial: You can now slow time, spawn enemies, set off arena mode, and switch characters, all with your gamepad.
 - Menu backgrounds.
 - Other smaller edits.

More to come!
